Produce a lossless, provenance-labeled canon that captures every product truth from all source inputs (Google Docs, prior phases, GitHub main, Beast clone, UMH projection, operator corrections) without mutation, implementation, or source modification.
description: Preflight checklist for CreatorOS canon reconstruction following the EOS lossless canon pattern.
center_of_gravity: CreatorOS is a creator-economy operating system — 'Whop on steroids.' The command center for modern creators combining content distribution, community, courses, digital products, marketplace, consumer feed, UGC campaigns, ads, and automation. Post once, publish everywhere. Host everything, sell to everyone.

ownership.note: CreatorOS is the creator-facing product. EOS handles business operations; CreatorOS handles creator product/distribution/community. Separate deployment, separate database, shared platform kernel via UMH.

hierarchy: User -> CreatorAccount -> Business -> Product -> Order -> Entitlement
design_identity: X/Twitter-inspired minimalism, NOT glassmorphism. Clean, fast, functional. Mobile-first social platform aesthetic. Bottom navigation, stories bar, feed-centric layout.

provenance_labels.SOURCE_PRESERVED_TRUTH: Directly from operator-authored documents (Google Docs, operator corrections). No interpretation.
provenance_labels.CODE_RESOLVED_CURRENT_TRUTH: Derived from reading actual source code. Code wins over docs when they conflict.
provenance_labels.SYNTHESIZED_CANON: Synthesized from multiple sources with explicit provenance chain. Analyst judgment applied.
provenance_labels.INFERRED_PROFESSIONAL_GAP: Gap identified from professional standards/best practices not stated in any source document.
provenance_labels.OPEN_QUESTION_OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED: Ambiguity or conflict that only the operator can resolve. Must not be auto-resolved.
provenance_labels.IMPLEMENTATION_DEBT: Known gap between desired state and current implementation. Documented for future work packets.

key_differences_from_eos.no_branch_divergence: CreatorOS has NO feature branch on Beast. GitHub main is the single code source. EOS has a 603-file feature/company-system branch that is the canonical candidate.
key_differences_from_eos.simpler_source_topology: One codebase (GitHub main = Beast clone) vs EOS's two divergent codebases requiring promotion decision.
key_differences_from_eos.auth_same_vulnerability: Same Passport.js broken auth as EOS, but no Clerk migration in progress (EOS Beast branch has Clerk).
key_differences_from_eos.more_contradictions_in_docs: 3 MVP scope definitions, 3 auth providers, 2 backend frameworks, 2 ORM mentions, 3 timeline definitions — more internal doc contradictions than EOS.
key_differences_from_eos.no_agent_hierarchy: CreatorOS PRD defines AI as utility-level (smart scheduling, content suggestions), not an agent hierarchy like EOS. UMH integration is aspirational only.
key_differences_from_eos.different_owner: CreatorOS owned by Empyrean Studio. EOS owned by OST.
key_differences_from_eos.design_divergence: X/Twitter minimalism (social platform) vs EOS executive command center (business cockpit). Fundamentally different aesthetics.
